about_the_game:
There's a terrifying urban legend about this tunnel

No matter how far you walk, you always end up back where you started—an endless loop. Those who enter never return. Night after night, only the anguished cries of trapped souls echo through the darkness...

"Tonight, we're going to uncover the truth behind this urban legend!"

As a paranormal video creator, you step into the forbidden tunnel. What awaits you is a bizarre looping space and one relentless zombie chasing you!?

But wait. There's something oddly charming about this zombie?

Each loop brings new surprises! Make the zombie slip on banana peels, trigger bizarre reactions with strange items, and more. Use quick thinking and simple controls to overcome 31 unique challenges and escape this endless nightmare!

What horrifying truth lies hidden in this tunnel...?

▼ Features

  • No penalties for failure - Casual design lets you challenge freely

  • 15-60 minute playtime - Perfect for quick gaming sessions

  • 31 unique challenges - Different surprises and laughs await each time

  • Horror × Comedy - A fresh experience that's scary yet hilarious

▼ Game Mechanics

This is a simple yet deep casual action game set in a tunnel.

Players navigate through the tunnel toward the exit while evading the pursuing zombie. However, reaching the exit doesn't mean escape—you're mysteriously sent back to the starting point. This loop structure is the game's core feature, with stage layouts and challenges changing with each loop.

With 31 different stage challenges, you must fulfill specific conditions for each to ultimately escape the tunnel.

There are no penalties for failing challenges or getting caught by the zombie—reaching the exit lets you progress to the next loop. This allows even players who aren't confident with action games to enjoy the experience through casual, repeated attempts.
